stories.title: What to know for NFL Week 3: 15 games on deck, 15 previews from our reporters and experts
stories.summary: Jalen Hurts against Chicago. Aaron Glenn back in Detroit. Dak vs. Lamar. We have picks, predictions, key stats and more.

stories.title: Why Mike LaFleur vs. Kyle Shanahan goes deeper than Cardinals vs. 49ers
stories.summary: LaFleur's career will come full circle Sunday, when he faces Shanahan in a key NFC West battle.

stories.title: Commanders GM: Elbow surgery, IR 'not on table' right now for QB Daniels
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels won't undergo surgery on his dislocated left elbow and, as of now, he won't be placed on injured reserve according to general manager Adam Peters.

stories.title: Man City refuse to deny guilty verdicts in PL case of 115 financial breaches
stories.summary: Manchester City on Friday did not deny there has been a guilty verdict in the majority of charges of financial breaches in their legal case with the Premier League.

stories.title: Sources: Giants QB Dart scheduled for left knee surgery Friday
stories.summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart is scheduled to undergo surgery Friday on his left knee, sources told ESPN. The belief is it will be a meniscus and MCL repair.
